# File paths for source CSV files
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_55/training_0.csv"

# All source tables share these columns except the population column differs.

# Merge df0 and df1

                on=join_keys, how='inner')

# Merge the result with df2
